login.title: Welcome back
login.body: Sign in to see today’s Recovery, Strain and Sleep.
login.demoTitle: Know when to push, and when to rest
login.demoBody: Recovery, Strain and Sleep from your Fitbit Air, scored on your own server.
login.demoNote: This server runs on generated data. To use your own, set up a Google OAuth client (see <path>docs/setup.md</path>).
login.closed: Your data stays on this server.
login.invite: New to Pulse? Open the invite link you were sent.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.body: Your data stays on this server, visible only to you.
signup.firstBody: This server has no accounts yet. Use the admin email set in ADMIN_EMAILS.
signup.needAdminBody: Add your email to ADMIN_EMAILS in this server’s .env and restart it, then create your account here.
signup.inviteExpiredBody: The link was already used, has expired or was revoked. Ask whoever runs this server for a new one.
signup.inviteOnlyBody: Ask whoever runs this server for an invite link.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.body: Pulse doesn’t send email, so the person who runs it resets your password for you.
forgot.step1Email: Email the admin your username or the email you signed up with.
forgot.step1Ask: Ask the person who runs this Pulse to reset your password. Tell them your username or email.
forgot.step2: They send you a temporary password, and every device you were signed in on is signed out.
forgot.step3: Sign in with it, then choose a new password in Settings › Account.
forgot.mailBody:
Hi,

Please reset the password for my Pulse account.

My username or email: 

Thanks!
forgot.resetFromServer: Reset a password from the server
